messages:
tay (Docs): quick heads-up: product plans to change hosted default model to `redwood-1-rlhf` on 2026-04-18. we need a short migration note + update all quickstart snippets. who can take ownership? cc @omar @jia
omar (Eng): i'll run a repo-wide search for `redwood-1` and legacy streaming patterns like `choices[0]` and `client.stream()`. will list files and open a branch.
jia (SDK): SDK differences to call out: `client.generate()` -> `client.responses.create()` and streaming is now an async iterator of event objects. i'll craft a minimal compatibility snippet for the docs.
tay (Docs): Great. Keep the migration doc tiny: old -> new examples, a shim snippet, and a note about alias kept for 30 days. Also add a troubleshooting line: "errors about missing choices" -> point to streaming change.
lex (Support): Please include a one-paragraph support-ready blurb we can paste into tickets. customers are still pasting old quickstarts into repos.
sana (Product): We'll keep the `redwood-1` alias for 30 days and surface a console banner. docs should recommend explicit model IDs and include rollback guidance for Dedicated customers.
jia (SDK): Draft shim I'll add to SDK PR: ```js
// temporary v1 shim
function genShim(opts){
  const model = opts.model || 'redwood-1-rlhf';
  return client.responses.create({ model, input: opts.prompt || opts.input });
}
```
I'll attach it to tests.
omar (Eng): Found 9 matches in /docs and /examples. Pushing a branch with fixes and linking the file list in the PR.
tay (Docs): Thanks. timeline: docs PR by 2026-04-13, merged by 2026-04-16 to get preview builds before the deploy window. tag me for review.
ci-bot: Reminder: docs preview builds take ~15-25m. request previews before 2026-04-17 21:30 UTC.
lex (Support): Draft blurb: "Hosted default model changed to redwood-1-rlhf. redwood-1 alias deprecated for 30 days. Update SDK usage to client.responses.create / client.responses.stream. Contact support for Dedicated rollback." will paste to #support-ready.
jia (SDK): i'll include the streaming example exactly as used in quickstart so we don't diverge.
tay (Docs): Perfect. i'll open the migration microdoc and add the troubleshooting entries. ping when PRs are green. :white_check_mark:
